relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant: "The NM\_002294.2: c.444\_445insT (p.Asp149*) pathogenic variant was identified in the LAMP2 gene".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5); family history unknown because she was adopted, no relatives described. Markdown escapes: the paper Markdown prints the variant as 'NM\_002294.2: c.444\_445insT'; spans keep the backslashes, values drop them (NM_002294.2, c.444_445insT). Zygosity, inheritance and variant type are not stated for this variant (the Discussion's 'truncating mutation' is a general statement about Danon disease, not about this variant), so left not reported. Ages: the paper gives 21 years at presentation only; onset ('2 years before'), diagnosis and last-evaluation ages are not printed as ages, so left not reported. Temporal changes, not treated as contradictions: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome diagnosed 2 years before (pathways ablated) vs 'no pre-excitation' on the presentation ECG (checklist pre-excitation = observed from the WPW history); 'preserved biventricular function' on the first CMR vs later ventricular dilation and LVEF 34% (checklist = observed). Heart failure left not reported in the checklist because the only statement is hedged ('suggested ongoing myocardial damage and mild heart failure'). 'Poor academic performance at school' recorded as a feature but the intellectual disability/learning checklist item left not reported because the paper does not name a learning difficulty. Second-biopsy finding 'absence of eosinophils' and the first-biopsy 'no evidence of fibrosis' recorded as excluded at those time points. The etiologies 'ruled out in the patient' (drug allergies, hypereosinophilic syndrome, malignancies, vasculitis) recorded as excluded; 'infections' not recorded separately.
